headline: Zul'Gurub in 45:37 with no wipes and a Thekal record

mvp.headline: the most damage on Jeklik, Arlokk and Jin'do, top four on all nine
why: First on Jeklik, Arlokk and Jin'do, second on Venoxis, third on Mar'li, the Edge of Madness and Thekal

also.text: the most damage on Venoxis, Mar'li and Hakkar
44 dispels, 29 of them Venom Spit, and a Rebirth on Fluffycatto on Hakkar
parse 99 on the Edge of Madness and 96 on Thekal and Arlokk

overview: Nine kills on nine pulls in 45:37, against a usual 52:30 and a best of 39:28, with 20 raiders and world buffs on two of them. Thekal fell in 1:05, a new guild best.
Four deaths: Tysiv on Venoxis, Roguina and Orbywan on Mandokir (both revived by the Chained Spirits), Fluffycatto on Hakkar (battle rezzed).

wentWell.text: Thekal in 1:05, a guild best, with his one Great Heal kicked.
Edge of Madness in 0:28, a second off the best.
Hakkar in 1:50 (median 2:12), Dramima battle-rezzed Fluffycatto after he died at 0:31.

notes.text: 0:49, no deaths. Her one Great Heal went through.
0:41. Tysiv died to the Holy Wrath chain at 0:29. Poison Cloud hits ran half again over the usual (54 on 10 raiders, Empala 7).
0:52, no deaths, but her Drain Life healed her for 63k against a usual 23k. Cokedog, Tanknarok and Zimligemein each kicked one Drain Life over the night.
1:17. Roguina died to Guillotine at 0:19 and Orbywan to Mortal Strike at 0:37; both came back through the Chained Spirits.
0:28 (best 0:27), no deaths. Zimligemein and Fluffycatto parse 99.
1:05, a guild best (was 1:07), no deaths. Wizness top at 883/s, parse 98.
0:41, no deaths. Lyrica cleared 3 Delusions, Mohg dispelled the Hex.
1:50 (median 2:12). Hakkar's melee killed Fluffycatto at 0:31 and Dramima brought him back. Macharius was mind-controlled three times.
